trades.name: LAAF of today's high (6320-6323 reactive)
trades.quote: Because bulls have continued to struggle on rips, it may be reasonable to short a LAAF of today’s high if the 6320-6322 (or Thursday’s 6323 close) proves reactive. Any short needs to be kept on a tight leash for now. This would need to get through Monday’s 6309.75 high, and I don’t even have high confidence that it makes it to 6293-6296.
